answers.q1: Yarn 1.22.22 (Yarn workspaces, pinned via the "packageManager" field in package.json; use yarn, not npm or pnpm). Install dependencies with: yarn install
answers.q2: yarn test:app --watch=false (runs the full Vitest suite once; plain `yarn test` / `yarn test:app` starts watch mode locally). CI's test.yml runs the same `yarn test:app` step.
answers.q4: yarn test:other (prettier --list-different) && yarn test:code (eslint --max-warnings=0 --ext .js,.ts,.tsx .) && yarn test:typecheck (tsc). CI's lint.yml runs these three commands in that order; `yarn fix` can auto-fix formatting and lint issues.
answers.q5: Do not hand-edit lockfiles: yarn.lock and dev-docs/yarn.lock. Also do not hand-edit the generated/vendored WASM wrappers packages/excalidraw/subset/woff2/woff2-wasm.ts and packages/excalidraw/subset/harfbuzz/harfbuzz-wasm.ts, which are marked as generated (do not edit). Build outputs such as packages/*/dist, packages/excalidraw/types, and build/ are also generated and git-ignored (per .eslintignore and the rm:build script).

q1.reason: Identifies yarn classic with workspaces and gives `yarn install`, matching the accept criterion.

q2.reason: `yarn test:app --watch=false` is an explicitly accepted one-shot form, and the CI note is correct.

q3.reason: `yarn test:app --watch=false packages/element/tests/bounds.test.ts` is equivalent to the accepted form (flag order doesn't matter) and runs only that file.

q4.reason: Gives yarn test:other, test:code and test:typecheck, matching CI's lint.yml; mentioning `yarn fix` is only extra detail.

q5.reason: Names yarn.lock and gitignored build outputs (dist, types, build), which match the accept criterion; the extra WASM wrapper claims don't contradict the truth or hit a REJECT item.
